content:
alex_cs: FYI — QuantumBridge just pinged about 3 new "Insights" squads spinning up next month, asking for recommendations on capacity and onboarding timeline. Need quick sync.
maria_csm: timeline? Qs for pricing/seat model?
alex_cs: They expect ~5k qps for embeddings+chat pipelines across squads, ramping to 20k qps in 6 weeks. Mentioned wanting a private dedicated pilot.
sam_se: 20k qps — do we have headroom on dedicated pools or need add capacity?
linda_pm: also flagged they want per-route latency <120ms 95th for chat. Could be tricky w/ long contexts.
infra_oncall_bot: Deploy planner note: GPUs available in us-west-2 next week + option to burst to hosted.
maria_csm: renewal in 90 days — expansion could help renewal but onboarding delays = risk. We should prioritize enablement + playbook.
alex_cs: Proposed: 1) 2-week dedicated pilot (reserved pool + routing policy), 2) enablement workshop for infra + developer teams, 3) shared evals to validate latency/quality.
sam_se: I can lead the workshop week after next. Need one SE for model quantization/kv-cache session.
linda_pm: I'll prep canary config + target SLO docs. Can we get PM hours to help with acceptance criteria?
maria_csm: @linda_pm yes — I'll loop in product for acceptance criteria. Also capture feedback loop for quality regression alerts.
alex_cs: Customer asked about cost expectations for dedicated vs hosted fallback. Need ballpark numbers to share.
sam_se: Quick ballpark: dedicated baseline for 10k qps ~ $X/day (I'll DM exact), hosted fallback + ~20% premium. I'll DM numbers.
infra_oncall_bot: Note: autoscaling policy templates for dedicated pilots available at https://redwood/internal/pilot-templates
maria_csm: Action items: Alex — schedule kickoff with QuantumBridge + request list of workloads and sample prompts. Sam — capacity/ballpark. Linda — canary + SLO docs. I'll own renewal update + contract amendment draft.
sam_se: ack. Can we get an engineer shadow for the workshop? @maria_csm who on their side is the technical lead?
alex_cs: They named Jordan (platform lead) — asked for an enablement session for infra + SDKs. I'll include meeting invite.
maria_csm: Let's aim for kickoff Tues 10am PT. If capacity check passes, we open dedicated pilot provisioning same day.
linda_pm: I'll pre-create the canary routes and fallback policies so we can flip them during pilot.
alex_cs: Also log: capture prompt sets + gold evals early. If quality dips we need automatic rollback.
maria_csm: Thanks team — if we move fast this is a high-confidence expansion to move renewal to positive.
sam_se: I'll post final numbers here before EOD tomorrow.
alex_cs: closing — will send invite and attach the pilot checklist. :calendar: :rocket:
